issue.title: ERROR in RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded on production build and faulty export on module

body:
We had this same issue. Our app is private and I have no idea what causes this issue. We have downgraded back to Angular 4.4.6

We tried typescript 2.6.1 and typescript 2.4.2 . Issue occurs no matter what when using Angular 5

Wish I could offer more details

Hi, I'm having the same issue with an app that is growing each day.
I'm using a template called [Fuse ](http://fusetheme.com/angular) and I'm updating to version 1.2.1 (that updates Angular to version 5)




Using a blank template `ng serve` works fine. But when I add my modules it get this error:

```
ERROR in RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded
    at Set.add (native)
    at new Set (<anonymous>)
    at dedupeArray (PROJECT_FOLDER\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:15903:27)
    at flattenAndDedupeArray (PROJECT_FOLDER\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:15912:12)
    at CompileMetadataResolver.getNgModuleMetadata (PROJECT_FOLDER\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:15114:13)
    at CompileMetadataResolver.getNgModuleSummary (PROJECT_FOLDER\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:15041:52)
    at PROJECT_FOLDER\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:15129:72    at Array.forEach (<anonymous>)
    at CompileMetadataResolver.getNgModuleMetadata (PROJECT_FOLDER\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:15114:49)
    at CompileMetadataResolver.getNgModuleSummary (PROJECT_FOLDER\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:15041:52)
    at PROJECT_FOLDER\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:15129:72    at Array.forEach (<anonymous>)
    at CompileMetadataResolver.getNgModuleMetadata (PROJECT_FOLDER\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:15114:49)
    at CompileMetadataResolver.getNgModuleSummary (PROJECT_FOLDER\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:15041:52)
    at PROJECT_FOLDER\node_modules\@angular\compiler\bundles\compiler.umd.js:15129:72    at Array.forEach (<anonymous>)
```
	
After reading some problems of other people, I try seeing what happened to the memory consumption and I notice that the compiler crashes every time it went beyond the **500mb**


![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/13264154/33081701-b27fc302-ceb9-11e7-9db8-ccd19def798c.png)



I'm using:
Windows 10 - 16Gb of RAM
Node v8.9.1
Angular CLI v1.5.3

I hope it can help.
Regards
